# M1 Abrams Battle Tank Fan Remaster

> A fan remaster project for M1 Abrams Battle Tank, presenting restored scenario maps, a graphics comparison, a trailer, installation information, and original creator credits.

## Public resources

- [Project webpage](https://abramsremastered.com/): Project overview and downloads.
- [Restoration](https://abramsremastered.com/#restoration): Comparison of original and remastered graphics.
- [Scenarios](https://abramsremastered.com/#scenarios): Eight restored scenario maps.
- [Installation](https://abramsremastered.com/#install): Platform availability and installation instructions.
- [Credits](https://abramsremastered.com/#credits): Original creators and project acknowledgements.
